baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speaker is named as the brother of the people he warns, and he says that he fears for them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Kinship places the warning inside the endangered group. The brother's apprehension converts danger-announcement from detached threat into protective speech whose social cost is borne by an insider.

activation_trace.role: The kinship relation makes the warner a member of the bond he is trying to preserve.
The human collective supplies the immediate social body within which the warning operates.
Danger is announced to awaken caution, giving the brotherly bond a protective function.
Anticipation of harm is voiced by the speaker himself, marking concern rather than distance.

changed_reading.before: A messenger reports a threat to a resistant population.
changed_reading.after: An insider exposes danger to his own social body, and his fear reads as costly kin-protection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command to remember, the passing of warnings, and the fore-and-aft construction surround the brother of Ad.
baseline_models.mechanism: Remembering re-presents a warning already located inside succession: earlier warnings have passed, the present brother warns, and warning also stands behind him. The ayah is therefore not an isolated recollection but another renewal of the same relay.

activation_trace.role: A reminder makes prior danger present again and lets this recitation renew its force.
Repeated danger-announcement is the content transmitted through the relay.
The passing of time and generations supplies motion through the warning sequence.
An intervening field places the speaker amid, rather than outside, the warnings.
The fore-position idiom makes prior warning immediately faced and available.
Alternating succession keeps warning arriving after warning instead of ending with one speaker.

changed_reading.before: The ayah recalls one old warning episode.
changed_reading.after: The remembered episode is a live link in a warning relay extending on both sides of its speaker.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition attaches to worship and makes God its sole exception.
baseline_models.mechanism: The worship root ranges from obedient devotion to being made servile or tractable. Exclusive worship can thus be read not only as cultic restriction but as refusal to let rival powers tame, own, or organize human submission.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience supplies the central allegiance that the prohibition makes exclusive.
The possibility of reducing another to servitude exposes the social stakes of misplaced allegiance.
Making a road or creature tractable provides the exploratory material image of submission being engineered.
The object of devotion fixes the sole legitimate destination of submission.

changed_reading.before: The command merely reduces the number of objects worshipped to one.
changed_reading.after: The command also contests every rival relation that makes people servile or tractable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feared punishment is attached to a great day.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day can denote a severe occurrence rather than only a calendar unit, while greatness can name a descending calamity. The warning therefore presents a concentrated event that overtakes its subjects, not just a date in the distant future.

activation_trace.role: Expected harm projects the severe event forward from visible grounds for concern.
Painful penalty supplies the event's injurious content.
A day understood as a grave occurrence concentrates time into a decisive happening.
A descending calamity makes greatness qualitative and overwhelming, not merely large.

changed_reading.before: The brother fears punishment scheduled for a future day.
changed_reading.after: He fears a decisive calamity-event whose advent will dominate the people's experienced time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The appointed cosmic term, the prior book, and the later book descended after Moses and confirming what faces it sharpen the focus fore-and-aft warning into serial confirmation. Different disclosures occupy successive positions but mutually stabilize one deadline.

activation_trace.role: Renewed remembrance lets an earlier warning function again in the present sequence.
Passing time carries warnings across generations without exhausting them.
The faced position provides the focus anchor for material confirmed from before.
Successive arrival supplies the open rear of the relay, where another witness can follow.
A fixed temporal limit gives the repeated warnings one shared horizon.
Temporal precedence establishes an earlier textual witness in the sequence.
Coming after what was before supplies the later station of the same relay.
Truthful attestation makes the later disclosure validate rather than replace the earlier one.

structural_cues: Packet order moves from a cosmic term, to an earlier book, through the focus warning, and then to a book after Moses that faces prior material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precedence, succession, confirmation, and a fixed term; I infer that warnings and books form one validating relay aimed at that term. A live alternative is that the parallels are chronological markers without a single transmission mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Warnings happen repeatedly before and after one another.
changed_reading.after: Successive warnings and books cross-confirm one another while converging on a single appointed horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worship creates an expected circuit of call, answer, nearness, and aid. The context breaks every link: invoked beings do not answer, become enemies, fail to help despite being taken as means of approach, and disappear. Exclusive worship in the focus becomes a warning against a dependency relation that reverses at crisis.

activation_trace.role: Submissive devotion supplies the allegiance whose expected reciprocity is tested.
The object made worthy of devotion defines the relation that must actually sustain its worshipper.
Vocal appeal opens the expected relation between dependent caller and invoked power.
Reply is the missing reciprocal act, exposing the invoked object's incapacity.
Hostility reverses the supposed support relation when the parties are gathered.
Aid and vindication identify the practical support the adopted powers fail to provide.
An offering used to seek nearness explains why those powers were adopted as mediators.
Their going missing completes the collapse from expected proximity to total absence.

structural_cues: The sequence progresses from no answer, to enmity, to failed aid and disappearance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, nonresponse, hostility, attempted nearness, failed aid, and absence; I infer that worship is functioning as a dependency contract exposed under pressure. A live alternative is that these are separate descriptions of eschatological repudiation.

changed_reading.before: Worship of other gods is wrong because those gods are false.
changed_reading.after: Misplaced worship builds a dependency circuit whose promised answer, nearness, and aid invert into silence, hostility, and absence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus joins exclusive worship to fear of punishment; 46:13 joins confessed lordship to standing straight and the absence of fear. The paired constructions make fear a diagnostic consequence of crooked allegiance rather than merely an emotion the warner deploys.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience names the allegiance whose direction sets the contrast.
Anticipated harm marks the adverse side of the allegiance fork.
Acknowledged lordship supplies the governing relation opposed to rival submission.
The sole object of devotion aligns confession with the focus prohibition.
Straightness and balance turn confessed allegiance into a sustained posture.
The explicit removal of anticipated harm supplies the positive side of the contrast.

structural_cues: Both ayat place fear upon a plural audience, but one predicts it while the other negates it after confession and upright persistence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusive devotion, confessed lordship, upright persistence, feared punishment, and negated fear; I infer a causal alignment-to-fear contrast. A live alternative is that the two fear statements console and warn independently without describing one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The brother uses fear to press a doctrinal command.
changed_reading.after: His fear identifies the consequence of misaligned allegiance, while confessed lordship made upright opens the no-fear alternative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parent-child sequence makes intergenerational transmission bodily costly, joined by obligation, and still vulnerable to refusal. The brother of Ad therefore models kinship as a burden to carry warning inward, not as authority that guarantees assent; passed generations intensify rather than cancel that burden.

activation_trace.role: Brotherhood anchors warning in a relation of shared descent and social exposure.
Danger-announcement is the difficult content carried through the kin relation.
An obligation passed onward makes transmission a binding relational charge.
Parenthood identifies the concrete intergenerational bond across which duty travels.
Bodily carrying gives transmission a material cost before it becomes speech or instruction.
Endured hardship prevents kinship from being treated as an effortless credential.
Generations joined within their own times supply the repeating social units of rejection.
The passing of prior generations is the very claim used to resist inherited warning.

structural_cues: The child rejects the parents' warning even while they plead for divine aid; the aid root has no packet branch inventory and is used only as a structural cue.
The focus likewise places warning inside a kin relation without reporting that kinship secures reception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies costly parenthood, transmitted obligation, a rejecting child, and passed generations; I infer that this family sequence analogically sharpens the brother's intra-people burden. A live alternative is that the household scene and the Ad scene make independent ethical points.

changed_reading.before: Calling the warner a brother mainly establishes local identity.
changed_reading.after: Brotherhood marks the costly duty to carry warning through kinship even when shared descent cannot compel reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context activates the focus landscape as an interpretive apparatus. An approaching cloud spans the valleys and is read as rain, but it is the hastened wind carrying punishment; its passage leaves only dwellings visible. The warned event arrives through the same material signs that desire mislabels as benefit.

activation_trace.role: Curved sand terrain gives the warning a material horizon rather than a generic setting.
Painful penalty names what the landscape will unexpectedly deliver.
The severe occurrence can enter experienced time through an approaching phenomenon.
A phenomenon appearing from one direction supplies the ambiguous object of recognition.
Valleys as flood channels explain why the approaching mass is read through hoped-for water.
Water descending from cloud supplies the desired but mistaken forecast.
Hastening collapses the distance between taunted warning and arriving event.
Moving air replaces the expected water as the physical carrier.
The penalty is located inside the moving air, completing the expectation reversal.
Root-level annihilation supplies the wind's causal outcome.
The surviving habitations become empty spatial evidence of the people removed.

structural_cues: The explicit correction from expected rain to the very event they hastened turns perception itself into the narrative hinge.
Only the dwellings remain visible after the carrier passes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dune terrain, valleys, an approaching cloud, expected rain, a correcting contrast, wind, punishment, and emptied dwellings; I infer that desire-shaped perception is part of the warning's failure mechanism. A live alternative is that the reversal dramatizes fulfillment without generalizing a theory of perception.

changed_reading.before: The focus warns abstractly about a great future punishment in a named place.
changed_reading.after: The place trains a test of recognition: the warned event approaches under the appearance of desired benefit and is understood only when that reading reverses.

context_deltas.mechanism: Possessing hearing does not help the deniers because knowing refusal blocks it; later listeners become silent and attentive, turn to their own people as warners, and call for an answer. Hearing changes from sensory possession into compliant uptake that reproduces the brother-to-people warning relation.

activation_trace.role: The insider relation supplies the social form reproduced when listeners return to their own people.
Danger-announcement is the content that receptive hearing converts into further speech.
Auditory capacity by itself supplies the negative case: a faculty can be present yet ineffective.
Failure to suffice shows that possessed capacities do not automatically protect or guide.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the blockage between sensation and responsive understanding.
Understanding joined to compliance supplies the positive form of hearing.
A mobilized group capable of aid makes reception collective and outward-moving.
Attentive silence is the posture that lets sound become understood obligation.
Directed turning carries what was heard toward the listeners' own social body.
The listeners become danger-announcers, proving that reception has reproduced the warning.
Answering speech defines the response the new warners seek from their people.
The caller's summons completes the relay from received sound to transmitted claim.

structural_cues: The packet places useless possessed hearing in 46:26 before attentive listening and immediate return as warners in 46:29.
The later warners address their people with the same insider social direction as the focus brother addresses his people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ineffective ears, knowing denial, attentive silence, understanding, return, warning, and requested response; I infer that receptive hearing causally generates messenger-like relay. A live alternative is that the later sequence shows conversion and mission without defining hearing in general.

changed_reading.before: A warning succeeds or fails mainly according to whether it reaches an audience.
changed_reading.after: A warning becomes transmissible only when hearing crosses from sensory possession into attentive understanding, response, and return to one's own people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene presents the day, confronts deniers with the reality they contested, and commands them to taste punishment. The focus warning is thus an offer of knowledge before the same truth becomes knowledge by involuntary experience.

activation_trace.role: Advance danger-announcement offers actionable knowledge before the event.
Painful penalty is the warned content later made experiential.
The grave occurrence brings the warned horizon into a present encounter.
Reality stable against falsehood supplies what the deniers can no longer redescribe.
Direct trial and experience convert disputed report into unavoidable knowing.
The same painful penalty closes the distance between prior warning and present verification.

structural_cues: A question about whether the scene is real is followed immediately by acknowledgment and the command to experience punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance warning, later confrontation with reality, acknowledgment, and experiential tasting; I infer an epistemic reversal from voluntary heeding to involuntary knowing. A live alternative is that tasting functions only as a conventional punishment idiom.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is the object of a threatening forecast.
changed_reading.after: The warning offers foreknowledge of a reality that refusal will later force the audience to know through direct ordeal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant counting map for the proper name Ad rather than treating it as the name's etymology. It remains anchored in the name, the great day, the appointed term, and the same counting map attached to a later promise; downstream prose should label it a split-root temporal resonance, never a lexical translation of Ad.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The proper name Ad has both its ordinary name branch and a packet-supplied non-dominant counting inventory beside the great day.

activation_trace.role: The tribal proper-name branch preserves the ordinary anchor and prevents the exploratory map from replacing it.
A delimited waiting period supplies the latent counted-horizon resonance carried beside the name.
The severe day gives the counted resonance an explicit focus-level temporal destination.
A fixed limit makes the broader context temporally bounded rather than indefinite.
The later promise resolves to the same counted-period inventory, echoing the focus split map.
Brief delay compresses the apparent waiting interval as its endpoint arrives.

changed_reading.before: Ad is only the historical addressee's proper name.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be a proper name, Ad carries an exploratory resonance of a counted waiting period closing toward the great day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the sweet-water branch beside the ordinary punishment branch of the same focus root. It remains anchored in the dune setting, the explicit punishment, and the later cloud expected to bring rain but carrying punishment; downstream prose should present it as a material lexical inversion, not claim that punishment means water.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dune location and the punishment root coexist in an arid scene where that root's inventory also contains potable sweetness.

activation_trace.role: Curved dunes establish the dry material field in which hoped-for water becomes salient.
Palatable fresh water supplies the surprising latent pole activated by the arid landscape.
Painful penalty preserves the ordinary focus sense against which the water pole reverses.
Expected rain externalizes the desired water reading before it is corrected.
Wind replaces water as the cloud's actual moving substance.
Penalty inside the wind completes the inversion from hoped-for freshness to injury.

changed_reading.before: The expected rain and the warned punishment belong to unrelated semantic tracks.
changed_reading.after: The arid setting activates a contained water-versus-punishment inversion: the cloud seems to promise fresh relief but carries the root's injurious pole.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fore-position idiom ordinarily supports a spatial-temporal reading, while this model activates the packet's non-dominant strength-and-shield map for hands. It remains anchored in the focus hand occurrence, warning on both sides, and later failed helpers and protectors; downstream prose should qualify it as a split-root protective image, not replace the idiom's ordinary syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Warnings stand before and behind the speaker, while the focus hand root also maps to strength and a guarding barrier.

activation_trace.role: Supporting strength lets the fore-positioned warnings be imagined as reinforcement rather than chronology alone.
A guarding barrier supplies the protective-cordon image around the endangered people.
The rear position closes the second side of the imagined warning cordon.
Danger-announcement defines the cordon's protective purpose: awakening caution before impact.
Failed aid provides the contrast between warning's offered protection and false supports.
Protective alliance names what nonresponders will not possess apart from God.
Inability to escape closes the alternative of evading danger after refusing protection.

changed_reading.before: Warnings before and behind the speaker only locate him in a temporal sequence.
changed_reading.after: They also admit an exploratory image of a protective fore-and-aft cordon whose offered aid false allies cannot duplicate.

strongest_changes: The fore-and-aft warning becomes a serially confirming relay of disclosures aimed at one appointed horizon.
Exclusive worship becomes a practical dependency test: false supports fail to answer, aid, remain near, or avoid turning hostile.
The cloud scene turns the Ahqaf setting into a mechanism of misrecognition in which desired rain masks arriving punishment.
Attentive hearing reproduces warning inside a new people, while possessed but resistant hearing remains useless.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah combines insider kinship, temporal enclosure, a materially curved landscape, and exclusive submission. Context activated both ordinary causal readings and packet-supplied split-root resonances: Ad as a counted horizon, hands as protective support, and punishment against latent fresh-water expectation.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact force of warnings before and behind the speaker can remain temporal, spatial, textual, or some coexistence of these.
The parent-child sequence may sharpen the brother's kin burden by analogy, but the packet does not explicitly equate household and tribal transmission.
The counted-name, sweet-water, and protective-hand readings depend on non-dominant branches and must remain exploratory rather than etymological claims.
